Langkawi 2020 — an offline map featuring most interesting places!

This offline map of Israel includes all the most interesting locations.

All the application's functions work without the Internet.

Install this app before your trip to Israel and you will be able to see your position at any moment, as well as any interesting places nearby.

You will also be able to add your own locations to the app (for example, your hotel, the place you parked your bike or car, or a store you want to return to tomorrow) and then you will be able to easily find these places using the app's navigation.

If you wish to have information about your company added to the map, write to andrei@solovjev.com.

If you have ever been annoyed by searching for the PDF Intercity ticket in your email inbox this app is for you. Change you Intercity PDF ticket into a pass stored into your Wallet.

The pass will appear automatically 2h before the departure and will be available on your lock screen with important information such as:
- QR code for ticket validation
- Seat and carriage number
- Relation of the journey
- Time and date of the departure
- Number of the train
